name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.channel.QChatChannelCreateActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen when a user starts creating a channel in a QChat server. The user enters a name and topic, chooses whether the channel is public or private, and creates it.
disableEffect: Users cannot create QChat channels through the built-in channel creation flow.
